ranked_causes.title: Truncated causal candle window in replay portfolio
ranked_causes.reason: Each bar, exit is re-evaluated on candles.iloc[:bar_index+1]. On the first bar after entry, end=start+1 in resolve_hybrid_b, so j==end fires immediately as a 1-bar time exit.

ranked_causes.title: Full-frame counterfactual in research simulator
ranked_causes.code_path: simulate_strategy → simulate_hybrid → bar loop to MAX_HOLD_BARS (72)
ranked_causes.reason: hybrid_b_proxy walks the complete post-entry frame (up to 72 bars), allowing partial close at +1R, SL hits, and true max-hold time exits — not available in truncated replay.

ranked_causes.title: No partial-state persistence across replay bars
ranked_causes.code_path: resolve_hybrid_b re-invoked from scratch each bar; partial_done resets
ranked_causes.reason: Even if truncation were fixed, partial close state is not carried on ReplayOpenPosition; each evaluation restarts Hybrid B from entry with full lot.

ranked_causes.title: Production policy matches full-frame resolve_hybrid_b
ranked_causes.reason: Production exit policy logic is identical between exit_policy.resolve_hybrid_b and phase27n simulate_hybrid(hybrid_b); divergence is data-window not policy.

ranked_causes.title: Accounting path consistent when exit_info matches
ranked_causes.reason: PnL uses exit_info from resolve_hybrid_b _finalize; when truncated replay forces early time exit, accounting correctly records the wrong-duration outcome.

ranked_causes.title: Spread and slippage not a material PF driver
ranked_causes.code_path: spread parameter stored; PaperBroker bar resolution has no slippage model
ranked_causes.reason: Both production replay and simulator use PaperBroker with fixed spread=0.30; no slippage delta.

ranked_causes.title: Trailing logic not involved
ranked_causes.code_path: effective_sl unchanged; no trailing in Hybrid B
ranked_causes.reason: Hybrid B maintains original SL; trailing_atr is not in production or proxy path.

ranked_causes.title: Candle alignment acceptable at M5 resolution
ranked_causes.reason: Entry timestamps align to M5 bar opens; close matches fill_price on entry bar. Not the primary PF divergence source.
